skill.summary: Upsell and cross-sell strategy — product recommendations, cart upsells, post-purchase offers, bundles

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial beta release introducing expert Shopify upsell & cross-sell strategy guidance.

- Provides analysis and actionable frameworks for product recommendations, cart upsells, post-purchase offers, and bundles.
- Generates step-by-step implementation plans tailored to your business.
- Includes tool and app comparisons, pros/cons analysis, and recommended KPIs.
- Designed for Shopify sellers seeking strategic guidance, not direct API integration.
